0022600147.text: The Trail Blazers (3-1, 2-0 on the road) come in on a one-game losing streak, sitting second in the Northwest, half a game back, and fifth in the West, while the Utah Jazz (1-4) are on a three-game losing streak, fifth in the Northwest and three games back, and 13th in the West. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (out, ankle soreness), Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), Ja Morant (day-to-day, hamstring) and Robert Williams III (day-to-day, knee), with Morant and Williams both listed as game-time decisions, while Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (out, knee), Jusuf Nurkic (out, foot strain) and Trey Alexander (out, knee bruise), and Lauri Markkanen (day-to-day, wrist) is also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, but Portland won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 124-114 win over Utah in Portland on March 13, 2026.
